value.rationale: Gives a complete and natural next-integer exact answer N*(-3)=14 to the component-count question explicitly posed by Defant, including all thirteen gaps. The drastic component growth from the exact -2 result is mathematically motivated by the changing prime-local factors, and this full closure decomposition is useful for studying the component-spectrum and proposed monotonicity, without claiming to settle those conjectures.
